target: Execution plan 1.3 / amendment log 2026-08-20: 'adjudication performed by Claude per Rehan's delegation, with Rehan spot-check to follow (10 flagged cases)'
flaw: The adjudicated-80 'human anchor' that gates jury membership, validates the negation fix, and anchors all Ch4 label-quality claims was produced by an LLM (Claude), not a pathologist. Rehan's 10-case spot-check is still 'pending', so the entire label ground-truth chain is LLM-self-referential — the classic self-validation loop of LLM-assisted research.
fix: Complete R.4 before any Ch4 claim: have a pathologist (Rehan or colleague) grade the full 80-case adjudication set plus the required ~250-report sample blind to all model outputs; recompute every agreement/kappa against this human truth; report Claude-adjudicator vs human agreement as a result in itself.

target: Jury smoke: 'Five models at 100% vs adjudicated truth (qwen3 14b/32b, gemma3 12b/27b, phi4)' used to validate the jury
flaw: The 'truth' the jury is validated against is Claude's own adjudication of the same reports — near-perfect scores likely reflect convergence of similar LLM reasoning on the same text, not label correctness. Perfect agreement with a non-human reference is being presented as validation evidence.
fix: Validate the jury only against independent human grades (R.4); report jury-vs-pathologist agreement as the primary validation statistic; drop or heavily caveat all jury-vs-adjudicated-80 numbers until then.

target: 2026-08-25 'JOINT REFRAME': central claim REVISED from 'adding a second modality improves prediction' to 'WHERE AND WHY multimodal fusion fails to replicate'
flaw: The thesis hypothesis was inverted after all fusion results were known (OCCAMS null, TCGA null, ERIN delta CI crossing zero). This is textbook post-hoc hypothesis revision: the pre-registrations were written to test a positive claim, and the negative outcomes are now retroactively framed as the intended contribution, which no pre-registration ever specified.
fix: State explicitly in Ch1 and every chapter that the original pre-registered hypothesis was fusion benefit, that it failed, and that the reframe is a post-hoc deviation with a date; do not present the 'why fusion fails' framing as if it were the designed question.

target: Ch3 pre-registration primary endpoint swap: 'Ch3 = progression as primary estimand (grade-classification moves to Ch4)' in the 2026-08-25 reframe
flaw: erin_ch3_preregistration.md fixed grade classification as primary ('Chosen as primary because every imaged case contributes') and forbids 'endpoint swaps'; the endpoint was moved only after results existed. Moreover the original choice of the grade endpoint itself flattered the hypothesis (largest n, and the label is report-derived, inflating histology AUC to 0.9255).
fix: Report both endpoints under the original pre-registration with the swap flagged as a deviation; for the grade task, quantify label circularity by evaluating against the R.4 human-graded sample rather than report-derived labels.

target: SWG confirmatory contrast #1 in multiplicity_plan.md: 'late-mean fusion vs histology-only... Released CI [0.015, 0.071]' with Holm correction
flaw: The multiplicity plan was written 2026-08-25, after all SWG results were known, and its 'confirmatory' contrast is the winner of a seven-family comparison on the same data (acknowledged winner's-curse exposure) whose CI barely excludes zero and which does not survive against the best swept encoder (GigaPath deltas cross zero). A post-hoc 'confirmatory set' cannot be confirmatory.
fix: Label the SWG contrast exploratory with winner's-curse disclosure; the only defensible confirmatory claim is the pre-registered fusion-vs-CNV contrast (whose AUPRC CI crosses zero); consider a bias-corrected bootstrap or leave-one-family-out selection to quantify selection optimism.

target: occams_v2.json gen_only shuffled_auc = 0.5806 and tcga_probe.json tp53 AUC 0.355 with failed null (null_pctile_of_real 0.2)
flaw: The pre-registered decision tree's Outcome D says 'shuffled-label control away from 0.5... pipeline bug until proven otherwise', yet the genomics-arm control failure (0.58) and the TCGA probe control failure were never debugged before building the pooled n=446 necessity-probe positives on top of the same pipelines. target: Amendment 2026-08-21: 'necessity probes at n=446 (pooled OAC+GEJ) show TP53 AUC 0.678 and WGD 0.703... genomics IS partially visible at adequate n'
flaw: The n=446 pool mixes OAC, GEJ and STAD populations; the gain over the OAC-only null (0.36-0.48) could be entirely population/label confounding (class prevalence and histologic subtype differences), not sample size — the protocol itself concedes 'the pooled gain arrives with a population change'. Also the numbers are internally inconsistent: evaluation_protocol cites 'AUC 0.703 and 0.771' for the pooled analysis, but no results file contains 0.771 at n=446 (visibility_ceiling.json has WGD 0.7705 at n=403, a different analysis).
fix: Run the visibility probes OAC-only at matched n, and stratified by subtype, with working shuffled controls; reconcile the 0.703/0.771/0.7705 WGD figures and state exactly which n and cohort each comes from; report prevalence per stratum.

target: Encoder sweep pre-registration: 'No further additions mid-sweep' vs amendment log extending the grid 3→5→6 encoders (H-Optimus-0, Phikon-v2, H-Optimus-1) on 2026-08-21
